title: A wording gate whose option drops a few words of a fact is classed design, not delete
goal: bl_authority.class_reasons classes a gate on a content item whose options reword or drop a phrase inside one fact as design, and keeps delete for a gate that removes an article, a fact, a source row or other kb content. In SP-lsamtvsz BG-nzrj2n32's gate g1 (reword four old-name negations or drop them) was classed delete from the unchosen option 'Delete the negations', matched 'Delet'.

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a
it={'touches':['kb/public/x/y.md']}
g=lambda q,o:a.gate_class(it,{'question':q,'kind':'blocking','options':o})
want=[(g('Reword the four negations or drop them?',['Reword the negations','Delete the negations']),'design'),(g('Remove the article?',['Delete the article','Keep it']),'delete'),(g('Remove the source row?',['Delete the source row','Keep it']),'delete')]
print(want)
sys.exit(0 if all(x==y for x,y in want) else 1)

notes: SP-lsamtvsz retrospective finding (2026-10-14), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator.
